Numbered differences (header-exact-values.md, "The parent header"); the owner decides each at Stage 31

1. The girl switch hides on Now

The picture draws Both · Jenn · Jess on Now (All · 🐥 · 🦊 on the phone). Now has its own girl switch, so the portal's stays hidden there, as today; it shows on every other destination.

2. Viewing a girl keeps the kid's row; 44px buttons and switch cells

Row 1 keeps the kid's 52px buttons and 52px pink avatar (picture 44); the sub-bar buttons are 44px (picture 36) and the girl switch's cells 44px high (picture 42), the grown-ups' tap floor.

3. Parent Monthly has no picture

◀ Parent, "Monthly", ◀ month ▶ in the middle (between the arrows on a phone, "Oct 2026") and the Jenn / Jess switch; no badge.

4. The way back is in the sub-bar

The picture puts "◀ Now" at row 1's left; the build keeps the kid's row and puts "◀ Hub" ("◀ Back to weekly meeting" while a meeting waits) first in the sub-bar.

5. The Week's sub-bar has Switch; Confirm all and Mark reviewed are on the Day's

Confirming and reviewing are per day, with the child's name in the words.

6. The phone sub-bar has no picture

The iPad's parts with the words in the labels: ◀, the girl's name, ✅ (count), 🚫 (count), 📋.

7. Reading size default 1.2 (a question)

With nothing stored the grown-up pages read at 1.2; "Larger" is now 1.2 (was 1.15) so the default is a listed choice, and a stored 1.15 reads as Larger.

8. The portal's tabs as the picture

The current destination shows its icon, the others their word alone; ⚙️ App its icon; no date in the bar.
